notes.title: Trading Cards and a New Low Price
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10233439/4b2e532e6310a36cb920ee5daeede21774537663.png[/img]

It's taken a while, but Ookibloks trading cards are finally available. Collect them all to craft exclusive Ookibloks badges and earn profile backgrounds and emoticons.

Not only that, but Ookibloks has a new price! The game is now only $1.99 USD. It's now easier than ever to get your daily dose of monkey puzzle action.

notes.title: Ooki is back up on Mac OS X!
notes.notes:
Mac and monkey fans, rejoice for real this time!

After a series of fixes ("My bad" --Rob), Ookibloks is once again out for Mac OS X.

notes.title: [FIXED!] Ookibloks is now available for Mac OS X!
notes.notes:
[b]ATTENTION:[/b] 
[b](10/28/2015 15:20 EST)[/b] It took some doing, but the Mac build should be fixed and ready to play.

[b](10/28/2015 2:40 EST)[/b] Due to technical difficulties, we're withdrawing the Mac version of Ookibloks while we work on fixes. More news once the build is fixed.

[b](10/27/2015 14:51 EST)[/b] We've just found out there's a graphical problem happening when playing the game on Macs with retina displays. We're working on a fix.

Mac & monkey lovers rejoice!

Ookibloks is now available on Mac OS X for all your musical puzzle monkey needs.

notes.title: Ookibloks is now Live!
notes.notes:
At last, Ookibloks has finally come home to Windows!

We're super-charged to be able to bring this game to a new audience. Of course, work doesn't end just because we launched the game. We have plans to bring the game to OS X and Linux and we intend to continue updating the game.

This is only the beginning!
